scope: Strict advertised List create/edit and declared List detail reads over actual loopback HTTP, delegated to native Core.
observations: Creation with exact padded name, empty notes, presentation color/icon produces one stable native List and acknowledged recovery. Optional omitted fields read back as null; empty progress has string counts 0/0 and globalDone null.
Structured and text tool replies match. Reopening through the public Core facade retains content/timestamps/four hashes and typed mixed-source recovery.

Guarded notes/color/icon HTTP edits save at one checkpoint. A stale notes field rejects a whole name/notes patch without changing content or timestamp. Color conflict details encode both the current object and a later cleared null.

Optional clear updates only the declared fields. Exact old edit and creation replay return their original checkpoints without replacing later Unicode name or nulls; unrelated Item content/time/hashes remain unchanged.

Actual tools/list advertises both strict List commands. Forty-four invalid create/edit requests reject with exact operation IDs and property paths, no applied/prepared evidence, unchanged List detail and issued Item row window, and unchanged mixed-source recovery/Schedule forms.
limits: List catalogs, memberships/local completion/order/archive, Itineraries/labels and saved native UI remain separate slices.
No native data schema or portable-format change is introduced by this adapter slice.
ReadLoadTests remains excluded from affected regression; chosen-client/signing/reader, actual Share and physical CloudKit/account/interruption/performance remain required.
